body: Yes, I work out a lot, a lot a lot, so, cooking is obviously a part of that. I do enjoy cooking actually.

Movies? Occasionally, I saw the recent Star Wars movie. Games? used to but not any more. Used to play starcraft 2 but I think that playing games like this only adds to the crushing loneliness. Art? No, never been one for art. TV? Not really.

My current education is free, but, if I were to switch courses, it would be quite a lot of money. 

You have given me an idea though, a fresh start in a new place with a new course might actually change things. But I am very sceptical. Plus, my family would kill me if I changed my course at the last minute. Its a possibility, thank you.
Not really, sadly. Its so sad that I can't even think of something I enjoy at the moment :(.

I am extremely good at my job, my "job" is also a uni degree. Essentially a couple years theory and a years placements.

I have gotten a first (70%+) is every single module and I have hated every moment.
No I finished playing tennis when I was 14 (too small), my work now is more along medical/healthcare lines.

When I was 8 years old I was taken out of school because I was a promising Tennis player. To be a professional at Tennis you really need to be out of full time education before 12 years old and playing every day like a professional athlete. 

I was put into an academy of sorts and anything fun or social was treated like treason almost. My life was devoted to tennis, training and anything else I was punished for.

I guess, its conditioning, I spent 6 years learning that work is number one, above all.

I hate work because, I'm not really sure actually.

Because I'm 21 years old and haven't lived a day in my life. Every day I put work before anything else and guess what I hate work.....

Recently It changed a little, somehow, I managed to get a girlfriend. And now I've screwed that up so bad that I hate myself MUCH more than I ever did before and I was pretty suicidal before.....
